name: Bingles' Screwdriver
summary: Bingles' Screwdriver lies among the gear scattered across Loch Modan's northern islands. Gnome pilot Bingles Blastenheimer lost it when troggs plundered his crashed gyrocopter.

sections.title: A Pilot's Vital Kit
sections.body: Bingles Blastenheimer lost the tools he needs to repair his gyrocopter when he crashed into Loch Modan. Troggs on the nearby islands carried off his tool buckets, and the screwdriver was packed in one of them. Bingles needs the screwdriver to make fine adjustments as he repairs the craft and handles its armaments.

sections.title: Preparations for the Retaking
sections.body: Bingles works to free Gnomeregan from troggs and leper gnomes. He plans to combine his flying skill with volatile Blastencapper munitions for an aerial assault. Recovering the screwdriver, wrench, and hammer will help him rebuild his gyrocopter and keep the airborne counteroffensive alive.

faq.answer: Troggs scattered Bingles' Toolbuckets across the islands in northern Loch Modan after his crash. The screwdriver is inside one of them.

faq.q: Why is the screwdriver so important to Bingles?
faq.answer: Bingles needs the screwdriver and his other tools to rebuild his gyrocopter and prepare his explosives for the campaign to retake Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Who stole the screwdriver in the first place?
faq.answer: Troggs living on the islands in Loch Modan took Bingles' tool buckets and Blastencapper explosives after his crash landing.

faq.q: What other tools did Bingles lose in the crash?
faq.answer: Bingles lost his wrench, hammer, and volatile supply of Blastenheimer Blastencapper explosives along with the screwdriver.

angles.text: As a gnome, each recovered tool brings Bingles closer to rebuilding his craft and taking the fight to the troggs and leper gnomes who drove your kin from Gnomeregan.
As an engineer, you know a precisely made screwdriver is indispensable for intricate gyrocopter rotors and delicate trigger assemblies.
